notes: Structured query templates for the Shopify Store Audit, migrated to the current Two Minute Reports (TMR) MCP. IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE: the Shopify (shopify) connector is ORDER/SALES/CUSTOMER-centric. It has NO sessions, visitors, conversion rate, bounce rate, add-to-cart events, checkout-funnel steps, cart/checkout abandonment, or device dimension. Those web-analytics signals come from a SEPARATE ga4 connector (optional enrichment). So this audit has two layers: (1) shopify — sales, products, customers, discounts, order-attributed traffic source, geo, payments (always); (2) ga4 — sessions, conversion funnel (add_to_carts/checkouts/ecommerce_purchases), device, landing pages, bounce (ONLY if a GA4 property for the same store is connected). All queries validated clean against live shopify + ga4 accounts. Dates NOT stored — runtime resolves from today's date; compare_to_previous queries run twice. Shopify amounts are real currency. Shopify PAYMENT fields (payment_metrics/payment_dimensions) cannot combine with sales/order fields — the payment query is isolated.

queries.title: Store Sales Overview
queries.note: No-dimension period totals — powers the KPI dashboard. Run twice for month-over-month.

queries.title: Product Performance
queries.note: Sales side of products only. Product CONVERSION RATE / sessions / page views are NOT in Shopify — they need GA4 item-level data. Rank by revenue and flag returns/low units.

queries.title: Order-Attributed Traffic Source
queries.note: ORDER-attributed (last-visit) source — orders/revenue by source, NOT sessions or CVR. Use fv_* for first-visit attribution, or lv_order_utm_source/medium for UTM detail. Session-level traffic + CVR come from GA4.

queries.title: Discount Usage
queries.note: Blank/empty discount code = full-price orders. Compare AOV of discounted vs non-discounted; flag discount dependency.

queries.title: New vs Returning Customers
queries.note: Repeat-customer revenue share. customer_type splits new vs returning.

queries.title: Payment Methods
queries.isolation_rule: Payment fields CANNOT be combined with sales/order/product/customer fields (TMR group rule). This query uses ONLY payment_dimensions + payment_metrics. accelerated_checkout shows Shop Pay / express-checkout adoption.

ga4.account_id_format: numeric GA4 property ID (from get_connector_accounts) — only if a GA4 property exists for the same store
ga4.note: OPTIONAL enrichment. Only run if a ga4 connector/property for the store is available. This supplies the conversion-funnel, device, session, and landing-page signals that the Shopify connector lacks. Without GA4, those modules degrade gracefully (see SKILL.md).

queries.title: GA4 Funnel & Session Totals
queries.note: The real conversion funnel: sessions -> add_to_carts -> checkouts -> ecommerce_purchases. Session CVR = ecommerce_purchases / sessions.

queries.title: GA4 Device Performance
queries.note: Mobile vs desktop vs tablet. Mobile CVR = ecommerce_purchases / sessions per device.
